boundedAssessments.prep11.discovery: Bounded official Help release-channel, Splunk platform-blog and Cisco newsroom indexed searches for Enterprise 11/11.0/11.x found no qualifying version-specific announcement. Current 10.6 introduction and September announcements do not supply an 11.x release date, deployment mandate, upgrade edge, pairing, security baseline or Cloud authorization. This is not universal absence proof.
boundedAssessments.prep11.operator: Help 3.2 matrix: September 24; Kubernetes 1.32–1.37; Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0. Changelog 3.2.0: September 8; Kubernetes 1.32–1.36; Enterprise 10.6.0; Queue secretKeyRef breaking change. The canonical disagreement remains supported; neither source certifies 11.x.
boundedAssessments.prep11.architecture: Current SVA covers single/multisite topology, persistent storage, SmartStore and recovery. Nonclustered deployment is discouraged for redundancy. Recovery depends on cluster/storage design; these current architecture statements do not establish an 11.x design or migration requirement.
boundedAssessments.prep11.app-delivery: App Framework distributes apps from remote object storage but does not validate app compatibility. Removal and some restart steps remain manual. Premium Apps has distinct ES/ITSI architecture and supplemental-app limits. This does not establish 11.x premium-product support.
boundedAssessments.prep11.workload: Exact 10.6 indexed modes/activation/status sections support Advanced writable CPU/memory cgroups and all rule types; Basic admission only. allow_basic defaults false and must be explicitly enabled for Kubernetes. Basic omits pools/categories, requires explicit search_filter when listing rules, and expected Advanced preflight warnings do not prove misconfiguration. No 11.x parity inferred.
boundedAssessments.prep11.cloud-option: Lantern staffing, communications and post-migration transition sections support planning responsibilities and potential reassignment after infrastructure duties change. They do not guarantee staffing reductions, prescribe a technical path or authorize a Cloud/FedRAMP offering.
boundedAssessments.prep11.context-versioning: September 30 10.6 announcement explicitly asks apps/automation to use supported product identification rather than version number alone to distinguish Enterprise and Cloud. This remains current 10.6 preparation context, not an 11.x announcement.
boundedAssessments.prep11.context-ai: September 15 Cisco AI POD statement scopes Kubernetes architecture to self-managed Splunk AI. Assistant is described as available; Launchpad is described as later in 2026. No universal Enterprise 11.x deployment mandate or later feature delivery follows.
boundedAssessments.exact.branch-security: SVD-2026-1007 Product Status and CVE-2026-76288 Description/Mitigations retain Enterprise 9.4.0–15 affected/9.4.16 fixed and 10.4.0–3 affected/10.4.4 fixed for the enabled-Splunk-Web header-parsing DoS. No UF, Cloud or overall-current-security conclusion follows.
